source_name: Modeled from Eurostat HPI and HICP CP041
methodology: dividend_points holds modeled GROSS rental yield. annual_yield_pct holds modeled NET cashflow. Net = gross * (1-0.30) for vacancy, non-recoverable opex, management, maintenance and reserves. Financing, purchase costs and personal taxes excluded.
